metadata.title: Area stability of plank covers
metadata.abstract: We prove a conjecture of András Bezdek on the stability of plank covers of the planar disk $D$. Namely, we show that if a sufficiently small concentric disk $rD$ is removed from $D$, then every finite family of planks covering the resulting annulus can be re-arranged to cover the whole disk. For the proof, we show a strong stability result for a related covering problem. If the hole has area $a \geq 0$ then the total overlap is $\geq c a/r$ where $c>0$ is a constant. This overlap estimate is not specific to the disk and is applicable to all planar symmetric convex bodies. We develop two new ingredients: a pruning procedure and a flattening mechanism.

analysis.progressType: 覆盖稳定性猜想的证明
analysis.workSummary: 证明从平面圆盘挖去足够小的同心圆盘后，覆盖剩余圆环的有限板条族可以重排覆盖整个圆盘，并获得适用于平面对称凸体的重叠面积估计。
analysis.breakthrough: 解决 Bezdek 的板条覆盖稳定性猜想，提出可能推广的覆盖调整工具。
analysis.limitations: 要求孔足够小；常数、重排规则和适用尺度仍需正文核对。 当前为摘要级数学分析，主结果和证明尚未逐段核查；AI 披露另见独立核查记录。
analysis.priorityReason: 解决明确的覆盖猜想且工具超出圆盘情形，适合凸几何方向优先阅读。
